rows.text: Without calls, computes sixteen cofactor expressions of the 4x4 float matrix at `rdx` (sums and differences of three-factor products of its sixteen floats, held in registers and stack temporaries), takes the determinant as the floats `+0`, `+0x10`, `+0x20` and `+0x30` times the first four cofactors, and writes each cofactor times a factor to the sixteen floats `rcx`..`rcx+0x3C`, the factor being 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) divided by the determinant, or 0 (all outputs zero) when the determinant compares equal to 0 (an unordered determinant takes the division path through `jp`), then returns.
